coverage.method: Authenticated GitHub REST repository security-advisory inventory, fully paginated; only public published records with B1ueD0g accepted Finder credit retained.

boundary: Scoped inventory of eight previously relevant repositories plus repositories actually observed in advisory-related notifications since 2026-10-01; this is not an exhaustive search across all GitHub repositories.
Closed, withdrawn, and unpublished draft advisories are excluded; their private identifiers and technical details are not retained here.
Public advisories without an accepted Finder credit for B1ueD0g are not treated as personal findings.
A published advisory without a CVE is retained as a GHSA; lack of a CVE is not evidence that CVE allocation was rejected.
State and personal attribution verification only; no new vulnerability reproduction or exploit validation was performed.
GitHub advisory publication timestamps are retained in UTC; CVE identifiers are verified as current advisory metadata rather than as new publication timestamps.
